apps.label: JioHotstar

title_link.note: Links are https://www.hotstar.com/in/<shows|movies>/<slug>/<id>; the app's DeeplinkActivity accepts hotstar:// and https://www.hotstar.com (seen in the phone app; TV app unverified).

notes: JioCinema merged into JioHotstar in 2025: 'JioCinema' means JioHotstar.
Left rail of icons: My Space (profile), Search, Home, TV, Movies, Sports, Sparks, Categories. Focus in the rail expands labels.
Title page: 'Watch Now'/'Watch Latest Episode'/'Continue Watching S1 E4' first; 'Seasons' tabs and episodes below. 'Subscribe to watch' means no plan - don't press.
Live cricket opens straight into the player; language/feed choice may pop up.

home.looks: Dark UI with a left icon rail, a big hero spotlight with a 'Watch Now' button, rows (Continue Watching, Latest Releases, Popular Shows, Sports).
home.focus: Focus starts on the hero; DOWN into rows; LEFT reaches the rail.

detail.looks: Backdrop with title art, year/genre/language chips, 'Watch Now' or 'Watch Latest Episode' button, '+ Watchlist', seasons tabs and an episode row.
detail.focus: Primary button first; DOWN to Seasons tabs (LEFT/RIGHT), DOWN into episodes (LEFT/RIGHT), OK plays.

search.looks: Letter keyboard on the left, trending searches/results on the right.

profile.focus: OK on the focused profile unless the user named one.

apps.label: ZEE5
notes: Top menu (Home, TV Shows, Movies, Web Series, News, Live TV, Search icon). Title page: 'Watch' / 'Resume' / 'Watch Free with Ads'; 'Buy Plan' means locked - don't press.

apps.label: SonyLIV
notes: Media3 player. Left rail/top menu with Search. Title page: 'Watch Now'/'Resume'/'Watch Free'; seasons dropdown + episodes.

apps.label: Sun NXT
notes: Top menu with Search. Title page 'Play'/'Resume'.

apps.label: JioTV+
notes: Live channels grid / EPG. 'Switch to channel X': use its search or channel number input.
